review_evidence: Inventoried all 660 primary Lean files across nine unsorry archive packages (0001, 0011, 0028, 0030, 0033, 0036, 0049, 0059 and 0122): exactly 330 goal files and 330 paired library files.

A complete source-shape scan found a theorem/lemma/definition-style declaration in every one of the 660 files. All 330 goal files contain sorry as the proof hole for their mathematical statement, while none of the 330 paired library files contains sorry.

Representative pairs include arithmetic identities, finite sums, elementary logic, list lemmas and number-theoretic statements with corresponding checked library proofs. No content-level lossless exclusion class was found in this unit.
summary: Reviewed this nine-package unsorry archive slice; all 660 files are mathematical goal statements or corresponding proved library modules, so the complete unit remains primary-retained.
